author: fradamt
content: Would like to have a temperature check on raising the validator custody threshold. This has been proposed a few times in the past and had quite a bit of support, and it's a backwards compatible change that does not need a coordinated release. Not sure what the right governance path is for this, but anyway leaving the draft EIP here: https://artifacts.ethlabs.org/p/02ce416089715aadf064a64b9f9f78665cb505b51b9c5f01f4be893970aa19c5/peerdas-custody-threshold.html
